name: ORPHEUS (SSG)
summary: ORPHEUS was a historical superheated-superconducting-granule dark-matter experiment in Bern, Switzerland. It is unrelated to the microwave axion/dark-photon project of the same name and has a separate identifier.
detection_principle: A nuclear recoil heats a microscopic tin granule near its critical state, triggering a superconducting-to-normal transition. Pickup coils detect the associated change in magnetic flux.

results.summary: Preliminary nuclear-recoil dark-matter searches and detector operation were reported.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
